records.name: Lightweight PRD
records.problem: Teams start building from a chat message and discover the real requirement late.
records.solution: Write a one-page PRD, get one reviewer, and only then open the first ticket.

records.name: Risk-gated release
records.problem: Releases ship on a feeling rather than a check.
records.solution: Score each release against a short checklist; below the threshold it waits.

records.name: Blameless postmortem
records.problem: The same incident repeats because nobody wrote down why it happened.
records.solution: Within 3 days of any incident, hold a short review and publish the postmortem.
